205  EQUISETUM  HYEMALE.

EQUISETUM  HYEMALE.

Scouring  Rush.  Equisetacese.

A  rush,  growing  in  damp  soil  in  Europe  and  North  America.

The  tincture  is  prepared  from  the  fresh  plant,  chopped  and  pounded  to  a
pulp.

A  popular  remedy  for  dropsy,  suppression  of  urine,  gravel,  hsematuria,  gonor-
rhoea and  gleet.

Proved  by  Smith,  De  Korth,  and  Chapin.  See  Allen's  Encyclopedia,  vol.  4,
